c.n: Our group hosts the Court of Master Sommeliers L
c.s: Our group hosts the Court of Master Sommeliers Level 1 and Level 2 at Testa Barra. This is your guide: what the Court is, why to sign up, and how to get ready.

c.n: Dates from the Court’s calendar on Oct 31, 2026.
c.s: Dates from the Court’s calendar on Oct 31, 2026. Seats are booked with the Court. Jeffrey Baldwin is our Head Sommelier.

c.n: Two days with Master Sommeliers, then a 70-quest
c.s: Two days with Master Sommeliers, then a 70-question exam. Where everyone starts.

c.n: One day: blind tasting, theory, and a service pr
c.s: One day: blind tasting, theory, and a service practical. Pass all three.

c.n: The next course and exam, for working sommeliers
c.s: The next course and exam, for working sommeliers.

c.n: 305 people hold the title worldwide, 176 in the
c.s: 305 people hold the title worldwide, 176 in the Americas (Sept 2026).

c.n: Level 1 covers the major regions and grapes, how
c.s: Level 1 covers the major regions and grapes, how wine is made, food pairing, beer, sake and spirits. That’s most of what guests ask at the table.

c.n: The Court says the Certified Sommelier title “is
c.s: The Court says the Certified Sommelier title “is well recognized in the hospitality sector globally,” and the pin tells an employer and guests your skills were tested.

c.n: The Court lists server, bartender and support ro
c.s: The Court lists server, bartender and support roles for Level 1, and lead server, captain, assistant floor sommelier, bartender and manager for Level 2.

c.n: Both levels run at Testa Barra, part of our grou
c.s: Both levels run at Testa Barra, part of our group, so you study and sit the course close to home, next to people you work with.

c.n: “We advance the beverage profession through educ
c.s: “We advance the beverage profession through education, mentorship, and credentialing.”

c.n: England, 1977. The first Master Sommelier exam w
c.s: England, 1977. The first Master Sommelier exam was in London in 1969.

c.n: Founded 1987. It runs the courses in North and S
c.s: Founded 1987. It runs the courses in North and South America and Asia.

c.n: Create an account at mastersommeliers.org and bo
c.s: Create an account at mastersommeliers.org and book the Testa Barra date. Seats are booked with the Court, not with us.

c.n: The Court sends the Level 1 workbook when you en
c.s: The Court sends the Level 1 workbook when you enrol. Read it before day one: the course reviews it fast.

c.n: Anyone 21 or over: servers, bartenders, support
c.s: Anyone 21 or over: servers, bartenders, support staff. No experience needed for Level 1.

c.n: The Feb 24 Level 2 is for people who’ve already
c.s: The Feb 24 Level 2 is for people who’ve already passed Level 1. You can’t sit both the same week.
The Introductory Sommelier Course & Examination. Two days of lectures, tastings and service demos taught by Master Sommeliers, with a multiple-choice exam at the end.

c.n: The Certified Sommelier Examination. One day, th
c.s: The Certified Sommelier Examination. One day, three parts: blind tasting, theory, and a service practical in a mock dining room. You need 60% on all three in one sitting.

c.s: White: straw, yellow or gold. Red: purple, ruby or garnet.

c.s: White: apple and pear, citrus, stone, tropical. Red: red, black, blue. Then its condition: tart, ripe, jammy, dried…

c.s: Last line on the grid: sell the wine to a guest in two sentences or less. Every line earns points, so tick “No” when something isn’t there.
